an8.13:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhahi bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati,
an8.13:1.3: idha bhikkhave, rañño bhadro assājānīyo ubhato sujāto hoti.
an8.13:1.5: yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññepi bhadrā assājānīyā jāyanti tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti,
an8.13:1.9: jegucchi hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā,
an8.13:1.10: sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso, na aññe asse ubbejetā,
an8.13:1.11: yāni kho panassa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimbheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni tāni yathābhūtaṃ sārathissa āvīkattā hoti.
an8.13:1.14: kāmaññe assā vahantu vā mā vā ahamettha vahissāmīti cittaṃ uppādeti,
an8.13:1.16: thāmavā hoti yāva jīvitamaraṇapariyādānā thāmaṃ upadaṃsetā,
an8.13:1.17: imehi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgatve saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an8.13:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa,
an8.13:2.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti. pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati. ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
an8.13:2.8: jegucchi hoti anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā,
an8.13:2.9: sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso, na aññe bhikkhu ubbejetā.
an8.13:2.10: yāni kho panassa hontī sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimbheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvīkattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārisu,
an8.13:2.11: tesamassa satthā vā viññū vā sabrahmacārī abhinimmadanāya vāyamati.
an8.13:2.13: kāmaññe bhikkhu sikkhantu vā mā vā ahamettha sikkhissāmīti cittaṃ uppādeti.
an8.13:2.18: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yantaṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa santhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
an8.13:2.19: imehi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti, …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
